title: True or false: World regions, Europe
intro: Decide whether each statement about Europe is true. Every answer shows its source.

statements.text: Finland is classified in Northern Europe in the UN geoscheme.
statements.explain: The UN M49 standard places Finland in Northern Europe.

statements.text: Monaco is classified in Eastern Europe in the UN geoscheme.
statements.explain: The UN M49 standard places Monaco in Western Europe, not Eastern Europe.

statements.text: Holy See is classified in Southern Europe in the UN geoscheme.
statements.explain: The UN M49 standard places Holy See in Southern Europe.

statements.text: Czechia is classified in Southern Europe in the UN geoscheme.
statements.explain: The UN M49 standard places Czechia in Eastern Europe, not Southern Europe.

statements.text: Malta is classified in Southern Europe in the UN geoscheme.
statements.explain: The UN M49 standard places Malta in Southern Europe.

statements.text: Croatia is classified in Northern Europe in the UN geoscheme.
statements.explain: The UN M49 standard places Croatia in Southern Europe, not Northern Europe.

statements.text: Bosnia and Herzegovina is classified in Southern Europe in the UN geoscheme.
statements.explain: The UN M49 standard places Bosnia and Herzegovina in Southern Europe.

statements.text: Lithuania is classified in Southern Europe in the UN geoscheme.
statements.explain: The UN M49 standard places Lithuania in Northern Europe, not Southern Europe.

statements.text: Russian Federation is classified in Eastern Europe in the UN geoscheme.
statements.explain: The UN M49 standard places Russian Federation in Eastern Europe.

statements.text: Republic of Moldova is classified in Western Europe in the UN geoscheme.
statements.explain: The UN M49 standard places Republic of Moldova in Eastern Europe, not Western Europe.
